Dear colleagues,

We are writing to share some general housekeeping notes from Orchard Analytics. Routine questions can now go to our new shared inbox; there is no need to copy personal addresses any more. We are travelling together by shuttle and will sign in at reception on arrival. Please keep snacks free of nuts, as one visitor has an allergy.

These notes are shared for information only and do not call for any action on your side. Should anything be unclear, our usual contacts remain available during office hours.

Kind regards,

Ines
Orchard Analytics
--
